fullContentHtml:
UPSSSC PET Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the admit card for the UPSSSC Preliminary Examination Test (PET). Applications for the UPSSSC Preliminary Examination Test (PET) 2026 were accepted from 03 August 2026 to 07 September 2026. The examination is going to conducted on 25,30 October 2026 & 01 November 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their UPSSSC PET Admit Card 2026 from the link

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 3 August 2026
  • Last Date : 07 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 07 September 2026
  • Form Correction Date : 08 September 2026
  • Exam Date : 25, 30 October 2026 & 01 November 2026
  • Exam City Details : 12 October 2026
  • Admit Card : 17 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 185/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 95/-
  • PH : Rs. 25/-

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Click on the official Admit Card link given below.
  2. Login using your Application Number / Roll Number and Password / DOB.
  3. Your Admit Card will be displayed on screen.
  4. Download the PDF and take a clear printout to carry to the exam venue.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is UPSSSC PET Admit Card 2026?

UPSSSC PET Admit Card 2026 is the official hall ticket for the upcoming examination. Candidates must carry it along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
